'''Squad 7-Senth''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] assigned to the [[Garrison/Legends|garrison]] on [[Koovis]]. Comprised of ten [[Imperial Army trooper/Legends|Imperial Army troopers]], the squad was armed with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] and [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]] and carried two [[Repeating blaster/Legends|repeating blasters]].
